lessons: A proxy is validated by the betas it produces, not by whether it returns data. Six pages of this book reasoned from betas of 0.12 for a bank and nothing was looking at the fits.
An unexplained share that survives a change of instrument is a measurement; one that does not was arithmetic. Only MYX:5183's did.
The best evidence a name has ever collected can still be insufficient, and saying so is more useful than grading the evidence on a curve.
A story that reports a move is not a reason to expect more of it. 'Rises to three-month high' cites the price, not a cause.
Waiting is an action and it needs its own evidence. The same reading of sweep --due produced a duplicate run one night and the correct no-op the next; what changed was knowing the delay distribution.
